title: Grateful Dead Live at Robert F. Kennedy Stadium  on 1990-07-12
lineage: Dat Clone->Panasonic SV3700-> Marantz CDR 615-> CDR Ripped with EAC (No Errors) 	  Tracks Named -> Flac (Level 8) with Traders Little Helper and Tagged with Foobar 2000
source: FOB-Schoeps CMC3 MK4-> Oade P/S->Sony D10 Pro->DAT

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear audience recording captures an all‑time show highlighted by a spine‑tingling Dark Star tease in Foolish Heart and a soaring Touch of Grey.
ai_review.review: The tape, sourced from the front of house board despite rain, delivers spectacular, crystal‑clear sound that lets listeners feel the crowd’s anticipation as Foolish Heart gives way to a Dark Star groove. The performance is praised for an uplifting Touch of Grey and a heartfelt rendition of The Weight, making it an all‑timer even if some find the start of Touch of Grey gritty.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews are uniformly enthusiastic (5, 4, 5 stars) and highlight both outstanding musical moments and excellent sound quality; weighted average yields a high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as front‑of‑board in the rain, crystal clear, spectacular for an audience tape with no noticeable dropouts.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A gritty, down‑and‑dirty vibe that builds into a powerful second half; the crowd’s anticipation during Foolish Heart leads into an unforgettable Dark Star tease and lifts with Touch of Grey.
